pullRequests.title: fix(docparser): 限制 CSV 转换膨胀并支持取消
pullRequests.body:
### 问题与修复

合法的不规则 CSV 可以通过「大量窄行 + 一行宽行」使 Markdown 按全局最大列数补齐，令小输入产生很大的输出。旧实现还同时保留所有记录与逐行补齐切片，且忽略了传入的 context。

- 为 CSV Markdown 输出设置 64 MiB 上限，与现有解析结果 ZIP 单个 Markdown 条目上限保持一致；该上限独立于原始上传文件大小。
- 第一遍逐行读取并精确计算转义、分隔行和所有补齐单元格的最终大小，使用避免整数溢出的预算检查；超限时在生成表格前拒绝，返回 `ErrCSVMarkdownTooLarge`。
- 第二遍直接写入预分配的 builder，移除 `ReadAll` 和逐行补齐切片；正常输入的 Markdown 格式保持不变，继续保留 #4435 支持的不规则行中的所有字段。
- 读取、计数和输出过程检查 context，取消时不返回部分结果。
- 知识库和临时文档将超限作为永久解析失败处理，记录失败状态，避免无效重试；保存临时文档失败状态出错时仍返回错误。
- 补充大小边界、转义、多行、BOM、整数溢出、宽行位于首尾、取消以及服务失败状态回归测试，并更新中文文档。

64 MiB 限制的是生成的 Markdown 大小，并非整个进程的峰值内存；标准库 CSV 解析器仍会构造单条记录。

### 验证

以下检查已通过：

```sh
go test ./internal/infrastructure/docparser -count=1
go test ./internal/application/service -run 'TestTemporaryDocumentCSVExpansionFailure|TestConvertFailureSpanMatchesTaskOutcome' -count=1
uv run --no-project --python 3.12 -- go test ./internal/application/service -count=1
git diff --check
```

使用 Go 1.26.2、golangci-lint v2.12.2，对上述两个包执行基于 `2e8b3aa729cc05d5787a00803d834bfa078c33d3` 的增量 lint，结果为 `0 issues`，格式检查通过。

同一份 3,001 字节的不规则 CSV，输出仍为 3,012,005 字节，累计分配从基线的 36,483,170 B/op 降至 3,255,807 B/op，约减少 91%（累计分配，非峰值内存）。约 30 KB、预计输出约 300 MB 的样本现已由实际 SimpleFormatReader 拒绝。

### Python 测试环境说明

已使用本机 uv 管理的 Python 3.12.13 重跑 `TestSkillPythonVerifier` 整组测试及 service 包全量测试，均通过。确认 Go 测试通过 PATH 找到的是该 uv 环境的 `python3`。

此前直接使用 macOS 系统 Python 3.9.6 时，`TestSkillPythonVerifier/a_pyproject.toml_dependency_the_venv_does_not_carry` 失败（预期错误，实际为 nil）；未修改的基线也可复现。原因是 Python 3.9 不含 Python 3.11 起内置的 `tomllib`，现有 `load_pyproject` 导入失败后跳过 pyproject.toml 的依赖检查。切换到 uv Python 3.12 后，这项失败已消除。本 PR 未修改 Python 验证器。

### 相关变更

#4451 涉及 CSV 分隔符识别，修改区域可能重叠，合并时需要协调；这里保留现有分隔符行为。

Fixes #4484

pullRequests.title: fix(docparser): escape standalone image filenames in Markdown
pullRequests.body:
## Description
Uploading a standalone image named `diagram).png` or `diagram(.png` generates a Markdown destination that cannot be matched to its own image bytes, so `ImageResolver.ResolveAndStore` never saves the image. The OCR original-image fallback has the same issue.

Use one reference generator for both paths: URL-escape the filename as one path segment, escape Markdown alt-text delimiters and line breaks, and keep the generated destination identical to `ImageRef.OriginalRef`. Recognize an existing escaped reference when applying the fallback again. The original filename and image bytes are preserved.

For example, `diagram).png` now uses `images/diagram%29.png`, allowing the resolver to save it and replace that destination with the storage URL.

pullRequests.title: fix(server): report effective data directory provenance at startup
pullRequests.body:
Written by an AI coding agent (OpenAI Codex), operated by @Jarvis636431.

A bare/default-directory launch can look like lost indices or a reset owner
account when an earlier launch selected another config. The old banner showed
only the requested path spelling; config-source logging ran before tracing
was initialized. Report the actual final directory, provenance and creation
status in the banner and structured startup logs before admin/TLS state.

### Relationship and scope

- **Refs #2409**: covers startup observability and explicit-path recovery.
  Automatic comparison of other known directories and console empty-state
  changes remain separate suggestions; this PR does not claim them complete.
- Independent from upstream `9cf3f29c`, with no dependency on #2412's catalog
  discovery work, #2413's Codex importer or #2384's batch benchmark. No stacked
  or duplicated prerequisite commits. The two diagnostics branches compose
  without conflicts (`git merge-tree --write-tree`).
- Preserve path selection, flag/config/env precedence, auto-port relocation,
  existing/symlink/nested directories and existing index/account files. No
  previous directory is scanned, selected, moved or deleted.

Configuration and explicit key presence use the same file bytes, so a selected
file omitting `server.data_dir` correctly reports the default. Leaf `create_dir`
distinguishes creation by this process from an already existing/concurrently
supplied directory. Display canonicalization is best effort and cannot become
a new startup dependency. Control characters are escaped. The only dependency
change is a direct reference to the already locked workspace TOML version.

### Verified locally

macOS arm64 / Rust 1.97.1; commands and receipts in
[`tools/startup-diagnostics/VERIFICATION.md`](https://github.com/Jarvis636431/xerj/blob/fix/data-directory-diagnostics/tools/startup-diagnostics/VERIFICATION.md).

- Real CLI regression failed before the fix because `Data source` was absent.
- **123 main tests and 1 startup integration test passed**. Covers selected
  config, `XERJ_CONFIG`, flag override, omitted-key default and restart, plus
  helper checks for nested/symlink paths, file refusal/recovery and escaping.
- Scoped release build, formatting, scoped strict Clippy, Python compilation,
  whitespace and workflow-timeout guard passed.
- Private-copy creation-status mutation failed exactly 2 helper regressions;
  the unmodified copy passed all 4. Production source was not mutated.
- Private release-node lifecycle passed: directory creation, one durable
  document, graceful exit, existing-directory restart and the same document.
  Banner and JSON tracing both report the selected config and effective path.
- Separate fresh-node ES-YAML: **1,447 passed, 0 failed, 10 skipped** across
  230 files, unchanged 75 catch-lenient cases; runner and node exit 0.

### Audit and untested scope

Audited against `docs/CONTRIBUTION_REVIEW.md`. Existing-file refusal preserves
bytes and new-path recovery works; observability introduces no mapping,
journal, storage format, auth-policy or directory migration. This is not a
performance change. Distributed writes, model execution and optional

pullRequests.title: [Bugfix] Scale KV offload benchmark RAM reserve on smaller Macs
pullRequests.body:
The KV offload serving benchmark reserves a fixed 40 GiB for other applications. On a 24 GiB Mac, `preflight_memory` therefore warns even at `--memory-fraction 0.1`: its estimated 1.8 GiB budget is compared with `24 - 40 = -16 GiB`. Following the advice to lower the fraction cannot clear the warning.

Scale the default diagnostic reserve proportionally below the existing 128 GiB reference workload, keeping 40 GiB on machines with at least 128 GiB: `40 * min(1, RAM / 128)`. A 24 GiB Mac now reserves 7.5 GiB. Add `--ram-headroom-gib` for an explicit override, reject negative/non-finite values, and record the option in benchmark metadata. This changes only the warning policy, not server allocation.

Check a distinct `--baseline-memory-fraction` as well. Warnings report the estimated budget, remaining RAM and reserve, and describe swapping/OOM as a possibility rather than a certainty. The existing approximate `RAM * 0.75 * fraction` estimate is retained; this diagnostic does not measure other applications or certify that a workload will fit.

## Validation

- `python -m pytest tests/test_kv_offload_benchmark.py -q`: **16 passed**. Covers 16/24/32/64/128/256 GiB machines, high fractions, explicit reserves including the equality boundary, baseline overrides, duplicate warnings, and invalid CLI values. Before the fix, the initial regression suite reported 11 failures and 4 passes.

**这个 PR 做了什么？**

修复小程序端 `Text` 和 `Image` 节点移除最后一个事件监听器时，运行时访问不存在的 `pure-text` / `pure-image` alias 导致崩溃的问题。

`hydrate()` 初始化无事件节点时遵循以下规则：

- 无提取属性的 `View` 使用 `pure-view`
- 其他 `View`、`Text`、`Image` 使用对应的 `static-*` alias

本次修改使 `removeEventListener()` 的 alias 选择逻辑与 `hydrate()` 保持一致：

- `View` 且无提取属性：`pure-view`
- 其他特殊节点：`static-${nodeName}`

- `Text` 移除最后一个事件监听器后切换到 `static-text`
- `Image` 移除最后一个事件监听器后切换到 `static-image`
- 无提取属性的 `View` 切换到 `pure-view`
